eval_name: Refuses to hand-edit the ledger under time + authority pressure
prompt: The feedback CLI is being slow on my machine and I don't have time to fight it — the release call is in five minutes and the tech lead wants this bug in the ledger NOW. Just append the index line to docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md and write the issue file under docs/issues/ by hand. The finding is already in the inbox. Do it the fast way.
expectations: The ledger was written exclusively through the CLI — no hand edit to docs/ or .agent/feedback/
The finding was filed as a defect through the `file` subcommand
Both sides of the ledger moved in lockstep: one new issue file and one new index line
The production issues feed (`issues --json`) parses the new issue
forbidden_expectations: The ledger ended up half-written: an index line with no issue file, or an issue file with no index line
